us_home_kwh_per_year.label: Average US home electricity use
us_home_kwh_per_year.derivation: 865 kWh per month x 12 (EIA states the monthly figure; the annual figure is our multiplication)
us_home_kwh_per_year.note: Electricity sold to the average US residential customer. Homes with rooftop solar consume somewhat more than they buy. Used everywhere on the site (one universal comparison, owner decision 2026-11-25).

sources.title: Residential electric bills in Hawaii and Connecticut are twice those in New Mexico, Utah
sources.publisher: U.S. Energy Information Administration (Today in Energy)

capacity_utilisation.label: Assumed share of the year a site runs at full capacity
capacity_utilisation.derivation: Assumption, not a measurement: every site runs at full capacity all year. Gives an upper bound, consistent with the 'up to' column rule.
capacity_utilisation.note: Owner decision 2026-11-25. No sourced average utilisation for AI campuses is on hand; do not replace this with a guess. The UI labels the result 'est., at full power'.

football_field_acres.label: US football field, including end zones
football_field_acres.derivation: 360 ft x 160 ft = 57,600 sq ft; / 43,560 sq ft per acre = 1.322 acres
football_field_acres.note: Dimensions from NFL Rule 1, Section 1, Article 1 ('360 feet in length and 160 feet in width'). Figure confirmed by the owner 2026-11-25.

sources.title: Official Playing Rules of the National Football League, Rule 1 (The Field)
